1.consolidated_definition: Caer inesperadamente o resbalar, especialmente debido a una pérdida de equilibrio o falta de apoyo; se refiere al acto de caer.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To slip or fall unexpectedly, especially due to a loss of balance or lack of support; refers to the act of falling.
